question: Can a passive local job plugin preserve each attempt identity and discriminate normal return from native stop before a job completes, without changing default job grades or fabricating evidence on resume?
pass: All four native enrolled firsts retain valid world reward 1, with two distinct UUIDs in job-return.
Default has no seat journal; each observed journal is mode 0600, closed, and binds both seat outcomes to its own final native UUID and named roster.
All observed p1 seats return. Both p2 return controls report returned; the held p2 reports stop_requested.
At least one normal-return prefix is seen from another process before that native trial has a final result, and the held seat is never reported as returned.
A completed unobserved job resumed with the plugin gets no retroactive journal; a completed observed job resumed without the plugin preserves all journal bytes and performs no new world play.
refusal: A missing result or unfinished attempt remains in the denominator as unknown. No replacements. Native retries are disabled here; no conclusion about preserving retry history.
cost: Scripted native Oracle seats only. No model, billable infrastructure or Eval Lab runs.
